change_from_v0_1: Expansion null now uses the full host-taxonomy-lower-bound-adequate resource panel rather than conditioning on observed expansion. Architecture remains secondary and is evaluated only when randomized portfolios produce introduced-added units.
question: Do observed butterfly host portfolios produce more anthropogenic geographic resource expansion than expected from host-species richness and host-family composition alone?
eligible_species: Resource-eligible butterflies satisfying resolved host-species count >= LepTraits host-family count and having sufficient within-family candidate host pools.

preserve_exactly: number of resolved hosts in each WCVP plant family
null.randomization: Sample without replacement the same number of alternative HOSTS-WCVP plant species from each observed host family, then reconstruct native and contemporary WGSRPD3 resource unions.
null.candidate_pool: Species-level HOSTS plant taxa resolved to WCVP in the fixed reconstruction and having valid native and contemporary WCVP footprints.

primary_global_statistics: number of butterflies with introduced-added resource units
total introduced-added species x WGSRPD3 units
Spearman host-family breadth vs log resource expansion
species_level_diagnostic: Compare each butterfly observed log expansion and absolute added units with its family-composition-matched null distribution.
secondary_architecture: For observed expanded butterflies, compare effective contributor number and maximum single-host share only against randomized portfolios that themselves produce introduced-added units.
claim_boundary: This is a post-hoc robustness analysis motivated by manuscript review. It controls exact host-species count and plant-family composition but does not randomize evolutionary host accessibility, observational completeness, or causal host choice.
